en-US.name: Luckin My Coffee
en-US.summary: Browse and manage Luckin Coffee orders. Requires separately configured Luckin MCP access and account authorization; purchases cost extra and require confirmation. CC BY-ND 4.0: redistribute only unchanged with attribution.

zh-CN.name: 瑞幸下单助手
zh-CN.summary: 查询和管理瑞幸咖啡订单。需另行配置瑞幸 MCP 并完成账户授权；实际消费另付费且需确认。适用 CC BY-ND 4.0：再分发须保留署名且不得分发修改版。

requirements.value: Separately configured Luckin MCP service and an operator-authorized Luckin account/token. Keep credentials in private host configuration, not chat transcripts or this public catalog; verify connection readiness before any call.

Luckin platform terms and real purchase charges apply separately. Obtain explicit confirmation before order/payment actions and stop when authorization, required details or services are unavailable. CC BY-ND 4.0 permits attributed redistribution of the unchanged upstream package, not distribution of modified material.
